privacy.cookies.text: Only necessary items are stored (cart, session, preferences, cookie choice). Optional trackers are only enabled with your consent; refusing is as easy as accepting.

privacy.formNotice: This data is only used to process your order or account (legal basis: contract). You can access, correct or delete it from "My data". Fictitious data only.
privacy.purposes.text: Account, order and delivery management (contract); invoicing (legal obligation); security and technical logs (legitimate interest); newsletter, audience measurement and personalisation (consent).
privacy.purposes.title: Purposes and legal bases
privacy.recipients.text: No third party. In demo mode, all data stays in your browser (localStorage); nothing is sent to a server or outside the European Union. No CDN, no external analytics.
privacy.recipients.title: Recipients and hosting
privacy.retention.text: Account: anonymised 3 years after last activity. Invoices: 10 years. Consent proofs: consent duration + 5 years. Technical logs: 1 year. Guest cart: 30 days. Cookie choices: 6 months.
privacy.retention.title: Retention periods
privacy.rights.text: Access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection and consent withdrawal, from the "My data" page. You can also contact the CNIL.
privacy.rights.title: Your rights
privacy.security.text: Hashed passwords (PBKDF2-SHA-256), sessions limited to 8 hours, progressive lock after 5 failures, pseudonymised logs.
